peer_identity.honcho_notes: Merge: id-format variants plus spacing/OCR artifact. Three ids, one entity.
peer_identity.rationale: Three ids for the same entity: the-technopope and technopope differ only in the definite article; the_techno_pope (vol01 single-record, underscore format) is the same character under an old extraction id. Fuzzy pair 'techno pope' / 'technopope' (ratio 0.952) confirms OCR/spacing variant. the-technopope is the cleanest and most complete canonical form.
